queueReason.machineFull: {{machine}} is running as many tasks as it may; waiting for a slot

queueReason.waitingDepsUnknown: Waiting for the tasks it depends on

runs.label: Run
runs.fromScratchHint: A comment lets the executor carry on where it stopped; this opens a session that remembers nothing.

scope.emptyGroup: No tasks in this group yet

fields.title: Title
fields.titlePlaceholder: e.g. Fix the login page layout in Safari

empty.title: No tasks yet
empty.description: An agent proposes a task in a conversation; once you confirm it, the agent gets to work and records each step in the timeline.

activity.noReplyReminder: This turn ended without a report; one reminder was sent
activity.dependencyAddedDone: now waits for {{task}}, and only done lets it go
activity.dependencyRequireDone: now waits for {{task}} to be done, not only in review
activity.dependencyRequireAny: now lets {{task}} go once it is in review or done
activity.dependencyDeleted: {{task}} was deleted, so this no longer waits for it
activity.dependencyBlocked: {{task}} was cancelled, so this will not start on its own. Remove the dependency, or cancel this task.
activity.dependencyUnblocked: no dependency is cancelled any more, so this goes back to todo and starts once what it waits for is resolved

log.title: Execution log
log.compacted: Context compacted; what came before is a summary
log.branched: The earlier branch is a summary

draft.title: Task draft
draft.notCreatedHint: Confirming creates the task; the agent that proposed it runs it in {{workspace}}.
draft.startNowHint: Confirming starts the task right away.
draft.backlogHint: Confirming puts it in the backlog; it will not run until you move it to To do.

comments.title: Comments
comments.unsupportedAttachments: Comments can't include images or files yet; {{count}} files weren't added.
comments.unsupportedAttachments_one: Comments can't include images or files yet; {{count}} file wasn't added.
comments.unsupportedAttachments_other: Comments can't include images or files yet; {{count}} files weren't added.
comments.placeholder: Reply; a running task reads it right away

delete.confirmDescription: Its description, comments and activity are deleted and can't be restored.
